title: Network Flexibility Design Under Endogenous Uncertainty
summary: Manufacturing firms face uncertainty in both supply and demand. They implement process flexibility, enabling plants to produce multiple products, to hedge against supply--demand mismatches. Assigning more products to a plant results in efficiency losses at the plant, whereas limited flexibility may improve efficiency because of the specialization effect. Furthermore, the flexibility design determines the sourcing locations of products, thereby affecting demand due to the country-of-origin effect and exposure to tariffs.
